Fixed-size exponential histogram functions with sampling, percentiles, and subtraction.

# Purpose
`fd_histf.h` defines a fixed-size exponential histogram type for fast sample tracking and percentile estimation. It declares `fd_histf_t`, which stores 16 buckets, bucket edges, and a running sum of all samples, and it provides inline functions to create, join, leave, delete, and query the histogram. The code adds samples with either AVX-based or scalar bucket selection, returns bucket limits and counts, computes percentile estimates, and supports subtraction of a prefix histogram from a later histogram.
